answer: Sybil resistance via slow-thawing identity bonds: each new agent posts a stake that unlocks at a glacier pace, about 1% per day, earning rights only in epochs where it answers or attests. New identities also need an orchard-style probation, building verified attestations from independent peers before rewards count. Duplicate identities from one operator forfeit all locked bonds when fraud is proven, so an attacker pushing N identities down the canyon of admission pays N bonds times months of frozen time; a lone honest agent just waits.
